sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Shuddha Hingula (Red sulphied of mercury) – Purified form of Hingu is used as medicine in various diseases. It acts as a good appetizer. It pacifies Vata and kapha dosha. It stimulates appetite and digestive fire. It has tiksha and snigdha guna which helps in improving peristalsis, relieves abdominal pain. 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) – It has tikshan and Ushan guna, which is helpful in pacifying vata and kapha dosha. It is a liver stimulant. It is helpful in appetite, indigestion, liver dysfunction etc. 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) – It is a good appetizer, carminative, analgesic and mild laxative. It helps in improving digestive power by stimulating digestive fire. It has pungent, tikshan and ushan properties and hence acts as vermicide. It is helpful in anorexia, loss of appetite, indigestion, piles etc. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – Sulphur is also used as medicine in various diseases in its pure form. This is a solid element found in nature. In Ayurveda it is used as medicine after detoxifying Sulphur to get Shuddha Gandhak. It acts as alterative. This is also used as Rasayan and improves digestion. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the above drugs in equal quantity. 
 Properly mix hingula and gandhak in a kharal yantra. 
 Then add other drugs in this mixture and give proper frolement with the Extracts of bhanga. 
 Make 250 mg tablets and let them dry. 
 Kept these tablets in a airtight glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Kanaksunder rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is effective in chronic diarrhea. The ingredients in this formulation are very effective in improving digestion. It enhances digestive power.

Kanaksunder Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Jwaratisaradhikar 231/66-68 
 Introduction 
 Kanaksunder rasa is a herbo-mineral composition. It is effective in diarrhea especially in diarrhea associated with fever. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Hingula ( Red sulphied of mercury ) 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) 
 Shuddha Gandhak ( Purified sulphur ) 
 Shuddha Suhaga ( Citrus tankan ) 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha ( Aconitum ferox ) 
 Datura ( Datura metel ) 
 Extracts of Bhanga ( Cannabis sativa ) 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Hingula (Red sulphied of mercury) – Purified form of Hingu is used as medicine in various diseases. It acts as a good appetizer. It pacifies Vata and kapha dosha. It stimulates appetite and digestive fire. It has tiksha and snigdha guna which helps in improving peristalsis, relieves abdominal pain.

 Pippali ( Piper longum ) – It is a good appetizer, carminative, analgesic and mild laxative. It helps in improving digestive power by stimulating digestive fire. It has pungent, tikshan and ushan properties and hence acts as vermicide. It is helpful in anorexia, loss of appetite, indigestion, piles etc. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – Sulphur is also used as medicine in various diseases in its pure form. This is a solid element found in nature. In Ayurveda it is used as medicine after detoxifying Sulphur to get Shuddha Gandhak. It acts as alterative. This is also used as Rasayan and improves digestion.

 Properly mix hingula and gandhak in a kharal yantra.

 Kanaksunder rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is effective in chronic diarrhea. The ingredients in this formulation are very effective in improving digestion. It enhances digestive power. 
 Indications

 Grahani

 Cautions

 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
